items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: We had a fellow named Henry Sappero ... played violin ... and doubled on banjo.

ctx.x: Joe Smith was on trumpet. We had a fellow named Henry Sappero (unintelligible) from St. Joe played violin (unintelligible) and doubled on banjo.
And then who was playing trumpet then when you were with them?
